hypotheses.reasoning: One malformed message, msg-895290 (partition 0, offset 721265), has a NUL byte at position 1260, so JSON parsing fails every time. The consumer has no max-retries, so it nacks and redelivers the message over and over (attempts 9 through 33 and counting). That blocks partition 0, and consumer lag climbs from 62s to more than 800s. CPU stays normal because the consumer is stuck on one message, not overloaded. The ingest-api 'timed out waiting for downstream confirmation' errors come after this and are a downstream effect. There is no deploy in the window, and the single GC pause (#200) is a red herring.
There was one 713ms old-gen GC pause just before the onset, but heap was only 64% after collection and nothing else points to memory pressure.

verdict.recommendedAction: Move msg-895290 (partition 0, offset 721265) to a dead-letter queue, or skip past it, so partition 0 can drain. Then set a max-retries limit with DLQ routing on the event-processor consumer, and find out which producer emitted the payload containing the NUL byte.
